response: In the context provided by the Copyright Act 1968 (as consolidated in 2002), accessory means any label, packaging or container where the Olympic symbol is not reproduced on it. It can also refer to various items such as written instructions, warranty information, instructional sound recordings or cinematograph films provided with an article, labels affixed to, displayed on, or incorporated into the surface of, or accompanying, the article, packaging or container in which the article is packaged or contained, and records embodying audio recordings. Additionally, a non-infringing accessory means an accessory made in a country that is a party to the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works concluded at Berne on 9 September 1886 as revised from time to time.
